records.route_label: Paquera Ferry Terminal → Puntarenas Ferry Terminal (Gulf of Nicoya car/passenger ferries)
records.finding: The Costa Rica MOPT 2024 statistical yearbook publishes a separate Paquera–Puntarenas directional passenger row. The latest annual value is 642,133 for 2024.
records.unit: one-way passenger journeys (passengers transported in the named Paquera-to-Puntarenas direction)
records.source_title: Anuario Estadístico del Sector Obras Públicas y Transportes 2024, Cuadro 6.2: Pasajeros transportados, según ferry, 2020-2024
records.publisher: Ministerio de Obras Públicas y Transportes de Costa Rica, Secretaría de Planificación Sectorial
records.source_date: 2026 (2024 data; source line says División Marítimo Portuaria supplied data in 2025)
records.quote: Cuadro 6.2 — Pasajeros transportados, según ferry, 2020-2024 (Miles). Paquera-Puntarenas: 2020 356348; 2021 537173; 2022 601358; 2023 660314; 2024 642133. Fuente: MOPT... con datos suministrados por División Marítimo Portuaria, 2025.
records.notes: Exact Atlas OD and source direction match. This is a passenger measure, not vehicles, tickets, visitor arrivals, or round trips. MOPT publishes opposite-direction Puntarenas–Paquera separately (645,372 in 2024), so no doubling or halving is performed. The PDF labels the table '(Miles)'; the extracted row renders six-digit integers. The normalized value here is 642,133 passenger journeys (642.133 thousand), not 642.133 million. ARESEP fare evidence was already banked and is not repeated or treated as realized yield. Evidence only; no finance materialization performed.

records.route_label: Puerto Cartí → Cartí Sugdup (Gardi Sugdub) community dock
records.finding: No public route-specific permit, motivated resolution, permit holder, or approved operator was recovered for this exact OD. Official Guna rules establish that operation permission must be granted by resolution, so route authorization remains permission-gated.
records.publisher: Congreso General Guna / Secretaría de Transporte Marítimo
records.quote: Artículo 123. El permiso de operación se concederá mediante resolución motivada.
records.notes: The quoted rule proves a permission mechanism only; it is not the requested route-level permit and does not name this OD or an operator. The official Secretaría page also defines a transit permit as a document issued by the Secretaría for a vessel to transit Guna territorial waters. The current AMP list of 865 valid auxiliary maritime-industry operating licenses (as of 2026-06-30) was reviewed but does not provide a passenger-route authorization for Puerto Cartí–Cartí Sugdup. General transfer/tour listings were rejected. A copy of the exact motivated resolution or written OD/operator authorization from the Guna authority is required.

records.route_label: Santa Bárbara de Samaná Ferry Dock & Cayo Levantado Launch → Sabana de la Mar Ferry Terminal (Los Haitises gateway)
records.finding: No primary operator page, authority permit, official timetable, or official tariff was recovered for this exact route. Commercial reseller evidence indicates a current ferry product but is not sufficient to identify the primary operator or promote timetable/fare data.
records.notes: Hard null under the primary-source-only rule. Civitatis currently sells the exact crossing for US$16 and displayed Samaná departure choices 07:15, 09:00, 11:00, 15:00 and 16:00 when retrieved, but Civitatis is a reseller and does not identify or prove the primary operator, permit, official service days, or official tariff. Rome2Rio, YouTube, Facebook, blogs, and tour sellers were also rejected. Published/seller fare must not be treated as realized yield. No finance materialization performed.

records.route_label: Cayo Levantado Public Dock → Santa Bárbara de Samaná Ferry Dock & Cayo Levantado Launch
records.finding: The Dominican Republic tourism authority confirms regular daily passenger boat-taxi activity from Samaná port to Cayo Levantado, but no exact-route passenger count, boarding total, ticket count, or directional annual series was recovered.
records.publisher: Ministry of Tourism of the Dominican Republic / GoDominicanRepublic
records.quote: Boat taxis depart regularly from the Samaná port on Avenida Marina, bringing visitors daily to this small island.
records.notes: The primary page is usable only as current-operation proof. It supplies no passenger volume, period, fare, capacity, operator split, or return-direction count. Dominican Central Bank tourism publications mention Samaná (Cayo Levantado) in cruise-port survey/statistical context; those cruise passengers/port visitors cannot be converted into passengers on the exact public-dock ↔ Samaná launch route. Hotel guests, excursions, whale-watching visitors, and cruise tenders may use different operators or landing patterns and are not allocated to this OD.

lane_conclusion: Two official 2024 Costa Rica one-way directional passenger counts are usable as evidence: 642,133 Paquera→Puntarenas and 317,859 Playa Naranjo→Puntarenas. Both Panama Guna routes remain route-authorization nulls and permission-required; no motivated resolution or approved operator was found. Samaná–Sabana de la Mar remains a primary-operator/timetable/tariff hard null despite exact-route reseller evidence. Samaná–Cayo Levantado has primary current-operation proof but no qualifying exact-route passenger volume. No finance was materialized.
